WITH matched AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
  FROM scanconservation AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
), grouped AS (
  SELECT zoneref, insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count,
         COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) AS record_fraction
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat
)
SELECT zoneref AS site_reference, insurstat AS insurance_status,
       record_count, record_fraction
FROM grouped
ORDER BY record_fraction DESC, (insurance_status IS NULL) ASC, zoneref, insurance_status
LIMIT 10;
